source_evidence: Player exact 'Find Elara and have a warm welcome and catch up with the party and the people of the estate'. V's group actually approaches familiar manor, greeted by Sela, who has the coach and horses directed into the attended yard and fetches Elara from household duties. Elara is physically present and independently pleased to see V, Mara, Cirren and Fenar; offers affectionate warm welcome and guest hospitality. Sela reports ordinary pasture use and no recurrence observed of the closed predator problem, not a new survey or repaired boarded lift. Party shares general road news (recent peryton encounter, everyone recovered); no scripted V dialogue, classified evidence disclosure, binding political commitment, legal registration or letter delivery/reply claimed. Anwen not present in this scene, no whereabouts beyond known Caereth connection inferred. No random roll required for ordinary familiar household access and welcome; no overnight, paid lodging, resource use or new charge. Time approximately45 minutes from approach through welcome and conversation. Elara offers rooms/supper and asks about V's plans; V retains choices. Known private engagement and V/Mara/Elara relationship respected; household staffing routine. Source owner NPC Lady Elara and prep/dm-only/dm-elara-estate.md Return/contact readiness. Day310~18:15 at Lady Elara Rethwyn's rural manor, V/Mara/Fenar/Cirren warmly reunited with Elara and Sela, other household staff tending ordinary duties; four healthy horses and coach brought into attended estate yard, Elara offers guest rooms and supper, no overnight completed, no V fee or new agreement. Anwen not encountered; no unverified legal inquiry or Nightglass correspondence outcome claimed. Elara asks how V wishes to spend his time here, conversation open. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned, dice delegated until stop. Fenar59/59 HD5/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift2/3 inactive MP6/6 climb40; Cirren51/51 HD4/6 all slots4/3/3 CD2/2 full. Mara healthy. LongRest2/6, purse391gp9sp6cp ration12/feed16, sealed PixieDust1, peryton antlers pair/feather bundle/two taloned feet in coach. D310 daytime quiet, no night roll/rest. Private compact Cirren, Kestrel originals V, Mara notes, Fenar reagents/tool unchanged. Planned Caereth then Orsaven remains. No private sensitive evidence disclosed or new political commitment. Await V's next action.
